name: Personal Project Knowledge MCP
description: Personal local knowledge and memory MCP - manage auto-loaded memories, Markdown documents, decisions, requirement changes, preferences, and project notes.

skills.name: personal-project-knowledge
skills.description: Portable skill for routing memory, document, decision, and requirement-change tasks to this MCP.

resources.description: Default usage guide exposed by the MCP server.
Storage roots and path rules for document inspection and migration.
Project context with full short memories and long memory indexes.
Structured JSON of project short memories and long memory indexes.

tools.name: get_usage_guide
tools.description: Read default server instructions for using this MCP as personal memory and document management.

tools.name: get_storage_info
tools.description: Show data root, document root, memory root, backups, and import conventions.

tools.name: build_context
tools.description: Build project context: short memories as full content, long memories and documents as indexes.

tools.name: list_loaded_memory
tools.description: List active short memories and long memory indexes that auto-load for a project.

tools.name: search_memory
tools.description: Search memory records by full text and metadata.

tools.name: get_memory
tools.description: Read a memory record by id.

tools.name: write_memory
tools.description: Write short memory or long memory index for preferences, rules, gotchas, decisions, and project notes.

tools.name: update_memory
tools.description: Patch an existing memory record.

tools.name: deprecate_memory
tools.description: Soft-deprecate an outdated memory and optionally point to a replacement.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects that have indexed memories or documents.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search indexed Markdown documents and return metadata instead of full body.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read Markdown document body by data-root-relative path.

tools.name: write_doc
tools.description: Write and index a Markdown document.

tools.name: resolve_doc_path
tools.description: Resolve a document path to its absolute file path and indexing state.

tools.name: patch_doc
tools.description: Replace text in an indexed Markdown document.

tools.name: move_doc
tools.description: Move an indexed document within the data root and update related long indexes.

tools.name: create_or_update_doc_index
tools.description: Create or update a long memory index for an indexed document.

tools.name: promote_doc_to_long_memory
tools.description: Promote a document to auto-loaded long memory index.

tools.name: demote_memory_to_doc
tools.description: Move an overlong memory body into a document and keep a long memory index.

tools.name: import_markdown_dir
tools.description: Bulk import external Markdown directories into the data root.

tools.name: migrate_markdown_file
tools.description: Copy or move one external Markdown file into the data root.

tools.name: extract_memory_candidates
tools.description: Extract heuristic memory candidates from conversation text without writing them.

tools.name: commit_memory_candidates
tools.description: Commit extracted memory candidates with confirmation guardrails.

tools.name: record_session_artifacts
tools.description: Record session documents and memory candidates; documents become long indexes.

tools.name: record_bug_report
tools.description: Record an MCP bug or confusing behavior as a bug_report document plus long index.

tools.name: backup_now
tools.description: Create a timestamped backup of SQLite database files.
